purpose: host whole-entry sentence-by-sentence precheck of long lore entries before the first EXECUTOR dispatch (window 28 lesson)

items: P1 aside from being split into predictably-sized chunks → 被分割成大小可预测的若干块（补 predictably-sized）
P2 anomalies and phenomena → 异常与现象（“规律”为误译）
P1 speaks to our commitment and loyalty → 体现我们的投入与忠诚（补 commitment）
P1 if she deserted or became demoralized → 若她叛逃或丧失斗志（补 deserted）
P2 uses the raging magic contained within（土壤中蕴含的狂暴魔法）to blast our foes with the fires they've caused → 保留“其中蕴含的狂暴魔法”与“他们自己造成的火焰”
P3 “我们的与生俱来的本性”语病，改顺
P1 Then, many years later, we were in the desert → 许多年后，我们身处荒漠（非“之后的许多年里长期居住”，删“无尽的”）
P1 The storms appeared again, weaker this time → 风暴再次出现，这次较弱（删“伺机对我们发动偷袭”）
P1 and it was truly delicious → 补“而且确实美味”
P1 magic, combat, negotiation → 魔法、战斗、谈判（非“辩论”）
P1 We were used to fighting by now … we did not mind it one bit → 我们那时已习惯战斗（非“曾经习惯”），如今知道战斗确有成果、能取悦无私的神，便毫不介意（非“什么都愿意做”）
P1 knowing they'd contributed another data-point to our Father's plan → 知道自己为父亲的计划又贡献了一个数据点（删“整个种族的发展”）
P1 The weaker members … willingly died off → 甘愿死去（非“慢慢逝去”）
P1 wanted us to determine our own destiny while he slept, recovering … → 希望在他沉睡恢复期间由我们自己决定命运
P2 lush jungle → 茂密丛林；knew where our next meal was coming from → 不愁下一顿饭从哪里来（删“居无定所”）

not_changed: Wretchling 酸液树魔 is the established Ashes name (19 uses); kept.
